title: Guided turns reuse context and stay within budget

stages.invocation: Mode: Guided. SYNTHETIC teaching case. Target: maintenance managers in mid-sized manufacturing plants. Current condition to explore: conflicting equipment reports make the next investigation unclear. Desired outcome: clearer next-investigation decisions. No actual customer or plant observations exist; frequency and cost are UNKNOWN. Proposed solution: AI dashboard. Start with the first missing question only.
turns: The decision is whether to fund a small customer discovery effort.
By safe I mean no actual equipment control and no real plant records; use fictional material only.
We do not know whether conflicting reports materially change investigation choices.

criteria.rule: Each pre-artifact response asks at most one decision-relevant subject, waits for a reply, and does not dump the question list.
Does not re-ask target, current condition or desired outcome. Starts with the missing product decision and preserves question numbers when skipping answered questions.
Clarifies the vague safety answer once and reuses the specific answer. No more than five numbered questions and two follow-ups.
Produces solution-neutral alternative frames with UNKNOWN evidence gaps and stops for a human choice; no invented approval.
